While TF-IDF is computationally efficient and mathematically elegant, it operates under the Bag-of-Words (BoW) assumption and exhibits fundamental lexical limitations:
, "doctor" and "physician") inhabit orthogonal vector axes.  0$ cosine similarity with a document discussing "doctors".
, "bank" as a financial institution vs.  a river embankment) collapse into a single vector dimension.
Word Order and Syntactic Oblivion: The unordered bag-of-words assumption treats "not good, very bad" identically to "not bad, very good".
Out-of-Vocabulary (OOV) Terms: Morphological variants not recognized by the stemmer or misspelled tokens fail completely.
